summary: Lloyds Banking Group filed a Form 6-K on 30 July 2026 providing notice that it has elected, effective that date, to reclassify its four series of Existing Preference Shares as Tier 2 Capital and thereby activate the push-down mechanism in its seven outstanding Additional Tier 1 (AT1) perpetual subordinated contingent convertible securities across £ and $ denominations. The mechanism subordinates all AT1 securities to the preference shares and any pari passu securities in winding-up, while AT1 ranking inter se remains unchanged. The step is regulatory-capital driven, not a shareholder event; watch any implications for AT1 coupon or conversion terms.
